seoTitle: GCPS Calendar 2026-2027: Gwinnett Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: GCPS 2026-2027 calendar with Aug 5 first day, May 26 last day, fall break, Thanksgiving, winter break, spring break, digital learning days and PDF.
calendarNotes: Gwinnett County Public Schools lists 180 student days for 2026-2027. The first day of school is August 5, 2026 and the last day is May 26, 2027. Fall Break is October 12-16, Thanksgiving Break is November 23-27, Winter Break is December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027, and Spring Break is April 5-9, 2027. GCPS also publishes 2026-2027 calendar PDFs in Chinese, Korean, Spanish, and Vietnamese.

calendarFaqs.q: When does GCPS start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Gwinnett County Public Schools starts the 2026-2027 school year on Wednesday, August 5, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is GCPS Fall Break in 2026?
When is GCPS Winter Break in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break school holidays run December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a teacher planning and staff development day, and students begin the second semester on January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Does GCPS publish translated calendars for 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. GCPS publishes 2026-2027 calendar PDFs in Chinese, Korean, Spanish, and Vietnamese in addition to the English version.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for GCPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Wednesday, May 26, 2027.

yearNumbers.label: School Year Window
yearNumbers.detail: The 2026-2027 GCPS calendar runs from early August through late May, with major breaks placed across both semesters.

yearNumbers.label: Student Days
yearNumbers.detail: The official calendar lists 180 student days across the traditional GCPS school-year schedule.

yearNumbers.label: Planning Windows
yearNumbers.detail: Fall Break, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, and Spring Break are the main family travel and childcare planning windows.
